Name: Andy Anime - alternative SVE portrait
Author: AurumRunar
Description:
[b][color=#3c78d8][size=4][font=Verdana]Description, Requirements[/font][/size][/color][/b]
This is a bunch of seasonal portrets for Andy, so you need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]SOSCA[/url]. Also can be used with alternative art mods, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30482?tab=posts]Donut's SVE Seasonal Anime Portraits[/url]. Either way, you do not install it as a usual mod. Pictures have to be placed into folder manually

[b][color=#3c78d8][size=4][font=Verdana]Installation instructions[/font][/size][/color][/b]
You need to unzip images and place them inside the mod folder, replacing original pngs in dominant mod. Depending on what mod and version you use, it will be directory, similar to this:
[code]stardewvalley\mods\Seasonal_Anime_Portraits-30482-1-4-1739501397\[CP] Donut's Seasonal Anime Characters SVE\assets\BunBunz[/code]or this
[code]stardewvalley\mods\Seasonal Cute Characters- SVE-5969-3-0-0-1715713453\[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE\assets\Portraits\Andy[/code][color=#3c78d8][size=4][font=Verdana][b]Thanks[/b][/font][/size][/color]
